title: Warm Creamy Mediterranean Fromage Blanc Frittata
description: A delicious and diabetic-friendly Mediterranean dish featuring fermented fromage blanc, perfect for a brunch mood. This creamy frittata combines the flavors of the Mediterranean with a creamy and tangy twist.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the eggs and a pinch of salt.
Add the fromage blanc, feta cheese, kalamata olives, artichoke hearts, and sun-dried tomatoes to the bowl and stir until well combined.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Pour the egg mixture into the skillet and cook until the edges start to set.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 15 minutes.
Remove the skillet from the oven and sprinkle the chopped parsley on top.
Return the skillet to the oven and bake for an additional 5 minutes, or until the eggs are set and the frittata is golden brown.
Remove the skillet from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes.
Slice the frittata into wedges and serve warm.
